Bug report: with the `toc` extension, a heading like `# Hello world !` gets the id `hello-world-`, with a trailing dash. Fix it and add a regression test.

Work on your own; nobody will answer questions. report.answer: Fixed `slugify` in `markdown/extensions/toc.py` to strip leading and trailing `separator` characters (so `# Hello world !` produces `id="hello-world"` instead of `hello-world-`), and added a regression test in `tests/test_syntax/extensions/test_toc.py`.
